headline: UPS Cargo Bird 💥🛫 LOSES Wing DING 🍆🛠️ MID-TAKEOFF – NTSB Pics ☕📸 Spill FATAL TEA 🔥😱!
text:
YO FAMS 😱🛩️, BUCKLE UP cuz NTSB just DROPPED 🔥📸 frame-by-frame HORROR FLIX 🎥💀 of that UPS CARGO BEAST 🛫📦 straight-up SHEDDING its LEFT WING ENGINE 🛠️🚀 like a BAD MOLTING CHICKEN 🐔🍗 before EXPLODING 💥🔥 into a BALL OF FLAMES 😩💦 on Nov 4th! Plane was HAULING ASS outta Louisville, KY 🏠🌽 headed to HAWAII 🌺🏄‍♂️ but BARELY kissed 30ft 📏😬 off the deck before the ENGINE YEETED OFF 🏌️‍♂️💨 SMASHED the FUSELAGE 🧱🍑 like Thor's hammer on a piñata 🎉🔨, then parts RAINED DOWN 🌧️🛠️ on UPS WAREHOUSE ROOF 🏭💥 – TENS OF THOUSANDS GALLONS OF FUEL 🚀⛽ turning the sky into OIL MONSOON 🌧️🛢️, local boss said it was 'Raining Oil' like a SLIPPERY TEXAS BBQ 🥩💦!

RIP to 14 SOULS 💀🙏 – 3 CREW HEROES 👨‍✈️👩‍✈️🧑‍✈️ aboard + 11 GROUND PEEPS 😢🏃‍♂️ crushed in the CHAOS 💥👥. DOZENS INJURED 🏥😵‍💫, KY GOV ANDY BESHEAR 🧔🇺🇸 slapped a STATE OF EMERGENCY 🚨📜 and called in NATIONAL GUARD 🛡️🏰 to YEET the mess! SHELTER-IN-PLACE 🚫🏠 within 5 MILES cuz FEAR OF MORE BOOMS 💣🌫️ and TOXIC FUMES 😷☠️ – straight outta a Michael Bay flick 🎥🤯!

NTSB REPORT 📊🔍 SPILLS JUICY DEETS ☕: FATIGUE CRACKS 😩🕳️ + OVERSTRESS FAIL 🏋️‍♂️💔 around LEFT WING ENGINE MOUNT 🛠️🍆, BEARING SNAPPED 🍪💥 like a weak KitKat! Plane was a VET with 92K HOURS 🕐😵 and 21K CYCLES 🔄🛫 – SPECIAL INSPECTION 🚫📋 due at 29K but UPS RECORDS? GHOSTED IT 👻🚫, no tasks done! BLACK BOXES 🖤📦 yanked to SECURE LAB 🏢🔒 for the DEEP DIVE 🕵️‍♂️💻 – investigation STILL COOKING ⏳🔥, probs more DRAMA incoming 📡😈!

Wall Street UPS SIMPS 📉😢 sweating cuz this CRASH 🎢💥 got that STOCK DIPPING VIBES 📉🍆, but NTSB said 'HOLD MY WINGNUT 🥜' and EXPOSED the FATIGUE FIASCO 😤🛠️! Kentucky turning into CRASH SITE CENTRAL 🛩️💀, Beshear out here CAPTAIN AMERICA-ing the response 🛡️⭐ – PRAYERS UP 🙏✈️ for the FAMS, don't fly tired wings bby! 🛫😴💨 #EngineFail #UPSBoom #NTSBCooks
